page.content:
Thunderer who defends Asgard and Midgard with Mjolnir.

How Thor connects

  • Weapon: Mjolnir — Thor wields Mjolnir against giants and the world-serpent.
  • Faction: Aesir — Thor is the Aesir thunderer who guards Midgard.
  • Character: Jormungandr — Thor and Jormungandr are fated to kill one another.
  • Event: Ragnarok — Thor kills the serpent and dies of its venom at Ragnarok.

What is Thor?

Thor, son of Odin and Jord, is the hammer-god who rides to Jotunheim and will face Jormungandr at Ragnarok. Farmers and sailors invoked him more often than they invoked Odin.

Key threads lead to Mjolnir, Aesir, Jormungandr and Ragnarok.
